step2.subtitle: Only the defaults change; nothing is locked in.

step3.body: Next, create your first issuer profile: the name, address and tax details that print on your invoices. We have filled in what you told us.

cookieNotice.body: We use only strictly necessary cookies: your session and your display preferences. No analytics, no tracking.

notFound.body: The link may be stale, or the document it pointed to was never issued.

forbidden.body: Your role does not allow this. Ask an owner for access, or sign in with an account that has it.

error.body: Nothing was changed by this request. Try again; if it keeps happening, the server log has the details.
